content_zh:
第2章 命运馈赠，绿森城市日报-《废土藏身处，从下水道开始升级》
第2章 命运馈赠，绿森城市日报-《废土藏身处，从下水道开始升级》
【恭喜你，鱼渊藏身处加入排行榜，目前名次为10000名，奖励100生存点。】
虚拟光幕被神秘的深紫色光芒渲染，一个造型简朴的木质长盒出现在光幕中央。
功能：每天获得一份免费早餐（包含一杯牛奶，一块面包），有概率出现需要生存点购买的额外食物。
功能：每天获得一份免费报纸，上面可能记载着一些情报，有概率出现需要生存点购买的额外道具。
功能：每天获得一份免费物品（医药、能源、建筑、电子、工具...）,有概率出现需要生存点购买的额外物品。
【温馨提示：选择馈赠后，作为代价，将抽取一张命运卡牌，请谨慎选择。】
content_en:
Chapter 2 Gift of Destiny, Green Forest City Daily - "Wasteland Hideout, Upgrading from the Sewer"
Chapter 2 Gift of Destiny, Green Forest City Daily - "Wasteland Hideout, Upgrading from the Sewer"
[Congratulations, Yuyuan Hideout has been added to the ranking list. It is currently ranked 10,000 and will be rewarded with 100 survival points. 】
The virtual light curtain was rendered by a mysterious deep purple light, and a long wooden box with a simple shape appeared in the center of the light curtain.
Function: Get a free breakfast every day (including a glass of milk and a piece of bread), and there is a chance that additional food will appear that needs survival points to purchase.
Function: Get a free newspaper every day, which may contain some information, and there is a chance that there will be additional props that need to be purchased with survival points.
Function: Get a free item every day (medicine, energy, construction, electronics, tools...), and there is a probability that additional items will appear that require survival points to purchase.
[Warm reminder: After choosing a gift, a destiny card will be drawn as a price, so please choose carefully. 】
